item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Users report login failures, account entry errors, token messages, and repeated requests for a new contact number.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Login and account access"},{"description":"Users report premium barriers, pricing concerns, payment or sign-up failures, missing paid access, and restrictions on free downloads.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Premium plans and entitlement"},{"description":"Users report missing songs, podcasts, or lyrics, along with dissatisfaction with recommendations and repetitive DJ selections.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Content availability and discovery"},{"description":"Users report stalled or unavailable downloads, deleted saved content, storage-transfer failures, and downloaded media remaining inaccessible offline.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Downloads and offline access"},{"description":"Users express general dissatisfaction, particularly with missing features, empty app experiences, and recent updates.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General app and update complaints"},{"description":"Users report interrupted or incorrect playback, playlist failures, connectivity problems, poor performance, and blank screens.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback and app reliability"},{"description":"Users report removed or hard-to-find controls, mobile navigation restrictions, and frequent advertising interruptions.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Navigation, controls, and ads"}]}
